A '''Massassi lance''' was a two-bladed [[Polearm/Legends|polearm]] used by the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] for close combat.<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> The Massassi lance was a very ancient weapon by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] but it was still considered as effective.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Combat%20Upgrade:%20New%20Weapons%20-%20Melee|text=Combat Upgrade: New Weapons &ndash; Melee}}</ref>
